purpose: Sealed holdout for one-shot evaluation of the first Once freshness policy against authentic external-read traces.

stopping_rule.note: Collection stops at the first point all four structural conditions are satisfied. Fingerprint outcomes, avoidance rates, change rates, or any future policy score must not influence the stopping decision.

include: Genuine external reads required during normal Once development, release, deployment, registry, documentation, or evidence work and deliberately routed through the frozen collector.
exclude: Reads performed solely to increase dataset size or create repeats.
Backfilled reads performed through other connectors or browsers that bypassed the frozen collector.
Any raw observation containing once_decision or another freshness-policy output.

policy_protocol.development_data: Dataset #0 synthetic/local fixtures only after Dataset #1 is sealed.
